typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPFACSInstrument_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSIP as string,
		SourceInstrumentID as string,
		InstrumentDescription1 as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		SourceInstrumentId2 as string,
		SourceSystemKeyId as integer,
		SourceInstrumentId1 as string,
		InstrumentId as integer,
		ISIN as string,
		SourceInstrumentIdType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FACSOLAPDWInstrument
FACSOLAPDWInstrument sink(input(
		CUSIP as string,
		SourceInstrumentID as string,
		InstrumentDescription1 as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		SourceInstrumentId2 as string,
		SourceSystemKeyId as string,
		SourceInstrumentId1 as string,
		InstrumentId as string,
		ISIN as string,
		SourceInstrumentIdType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CUSIP,
		SourceInstrumentID,
		InstrumentDescription1,
		SourceSystemName,
		SourceInstrumentId2,
		SourceSystemKeyId,
		SourceInstrumentId1,
		InstrumentId,
		ISIN,
		SourceInstrumentIdType),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPFACSInstrument_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPFACSInstrument
